title: Fast Inference from Transformers via Speculative Decoding
layout_note: A worked trace: nine monospace lines stacked top to bottom, one per decoding iteration, each repeating the growing sentence from [START] and ending with that iteration's newly proposed tokens.
grouping: No boxes or containers; rows are the only units. Colour marks token status: black = earlier tokens, green = draft tokens accepted, red with strikethrough = draft token rejected, blue = token supplied by the target model.
shapes_depth: Text only, bold monospace. Every token has a thin underline bracket with end ticks in the token's colour, showing token boundaries.
proposed_highlight: Colour alone: the accepted (green), rejected (red, struck through) and corrected (blue) tokens at the end of each line are the method; no legend in the figure.
lesson: Explain a decoding algorithm with a real sentence growing line by line, colouring each step's new tokens by outcome and striking through rejected ones.
notes: figure_type 'other' = a worked example trace on real text rather than an architecture diagram; the paper's other figures are plots (2-4) and a wall-time bar diagram (5). Venue from the first page (Proceedings of the 40th ICML); arXiv id is 2022.

arrangement.units: nine unframed text lines, one per decoding iteration
arrangement.inputs_as: quoted text: each line starts with a [START] token and the real sentence so far
arrangement.shared: the accepted prefix is repeated in black on every following line

taxonomy.task: faster autoregressive decoding with a draft model
taxonomy.note: architecture 'other' = a small draft model proposes tokens that the large model verifies; the figure draws only the resulting token trace

insights.structure: Nine left-aligned lines stacked top to bottom, each one decoding iteration, with the new tokens always at the right end.
insights.data: Data is a real sentence in bold monospace, every token underlined by a tick-ended bracket that shows its boundaries.
insights.emphasis: Green accepted, red struck-through rejected and blue corrected tokens at each line's end carry the whole idea against the black accepted prefix.
insights.flow: Read each line to its coloured tail, then drop to the next line, which repeats the prefix in black and extends it.
insights.avoid: The colour code is explained only in the caption, with no in-figure legend, and repeating the full prefix on every line makes the figure dense.

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)
